## History

George Moore visited his uncle in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) at the age of seventeen alongside his cousin, [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md). Before sailing on the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), George became engaged to a girl in his home town. When [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) contracted yellow fever in Cuba, George stayed behind to nurse him while the ship sailed without them, and [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) ultimately died. Back in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), it was later revealed through a letter from [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) that the man who had been cared for as [Dick](../character/dick-moore.md) was actually George.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P16](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), +1 more_

## Relationships

### [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dick-moore--george-moore.md)

George Moore is the double cousin of [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md), who died years prior to the events of the novel. Because of his striking resemblance to his deceased relative, George was mistakenly believed by others to be [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) himself. This mistaken identity was only uncovered after a letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealed the truth about Dick's death and George's true identity.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), +4 more_
